milestone.title: Auth session hardening
milestone.goal: the dashboard BFF verifies the session JWT before trusting any identity claim — delegating to the gateway's authoritative GET /admin/auth/me (no secret sprawl) — and the test harness reaches a true 0 unhandled-request leak, closing the carried v17 auth/me follow-ups with zero behavioral regression
